### Added

- **Liquid glass composer** (opt-in, Chat appearance): on Windows and Android the message field can bend the chat behind it like a frosted glass plate. Off until you turn it on; macOS and the browser PWA keep the solid field.
- **Playback speed**: a 1×/1.5×/2× button on voice and audio players (chat bubbles and the gallery player). The choice is remembered across messages and syncs through settings transfer.
- **Sending in the background** (Android): when a message is still uploading and you background the app, a silent "Sending…" notification appears until the outgoing queue drains. The send itself always continued; the card now shows it. It appears when the background-connection service already keeps the process alive (the default setting).
- **Category chips in the forward and share pickers** (#294): All / People / Groups / Channels / Bots / Saved filter the target lists — the same buckets as the main chat list's bar.
- **Haptic ticks on swipes** (Android): a short vibration confirms crossing the reply and back thresholds.
- **Message info: last app update**: for webxdc apps, the info dialog shows when the app last received a status update.

### Fixed

- **Pinned messages tray**: updates instantly when a pinned message is unpinned or deleted. The tray's event was wired to core event kinds that never existed on the wire, so until now it only refreshed on the next unrelated chat event.
- **Translations completed**: the remaining confirmation dialogs and toast notifications are translated — the French and Russian packs now cover the whole UI.
- **Text-only Auto** covers only unaccepted 1:1 contact requests, never group senders; plain text without real attachment metadata stays a normal text bubble (#310, #311).
- **Channel invitations**: **Invite via link/QR** is offered only for owned outgoing channels — incoming subscriptions and mailing lists no longer get an action the core cannot fulfill (#312, #313).
- **Chat-list startup**: a startup crash caused by reading collapse state in its temporal dead zone is fixed (#282, #306).
- **Relay invites**: an invite with no expiry date lasts 48 hours, and a failed PWA signup gives its use back so it can be retried.
- **PWA**: static installs no longer assume their own host relays mail — the page-host WebSocket proxy is opt-in per build (#307); web publication stops when the onboarding verification keys are missing instead of publishing unverifiable invites (#308).
- **Linux packages are actually attached**: v1.5.4's release job built but never published the `.deb`, AppImage, and Arch package. v1.5.5 attaches them (glibc 2.36 or newer: Debian 12, Ubuntu 23.04, Arch). Linux does not self-update yet.

### Changed

- **Messaging core 2.69.0** (v1.5.4 shipped 2.66.0). No database migration. The pick-up matters most for one fix: webxdc apps are no longer sometimes received as plain files. Secure-Join prefers the `vc-` prefix where accepted, long messages truncate at load time instead of save time, and marking messages seen queues read receipts in one transaction. Velta's quilt stays 200 operations across 37 files, re-anchored onto the new tree and clean under rustc 1.98's clippy.
- The archived DNS-tunnel library (replaced by the SOCKS5 proxy in v1.5.0) is removed from the source tree together with its deploy script and docs. Saved proxies and settings transfer are unaffected.
